last.verdict: Beat on sales and profit, raised the yearly outlook, and lifted the dividend.

reasons.label: Profit outlook raised
reasons.text: 2026 EPS guidance lifted to $13.95–$13.99 from $13.76–$13.96, despite Apogee deal costs.

reasons.label: Brain drugs beat
reasons.text: Neuroscience sales rose 19% to $3.4B, the quarter's biggest beat per William Blair.

reasons.label: Skyrizi and Rinvoq growth
reasons.text: Skyrizi rose 23% and Rinvoq 24%, more than offsetting Humira's 31% drop.

story: Since July, AbbVie's growth drugs Skyrizi and Rinvoq have kept growing over 20%. July's Apogee deal cost trimmed the profit outlook and the stock fell 2.5%. This quarter's raised outlook and bigger dividend pushed shares to record highs.

history.verdict: Sales beat, but profit missed and the Apogee deal trimmed the yearly outlook.

reasons.label: Profit missed estimates
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $3.65 fell short of the roughly $3.71 analysts expected.

reasons.label: Profit outlook trimmed
reasons.text: 2026 EPS guidance cut to $13.87–$14.07, below the $14.12 consensus, on Apogee deal costs.

reasons.label: $10.9B Apogee deal
reasons.text: AbbVie agreed to buy Apogee for about $10.9 billion, adding $0.14 per share of dilution.
